name: BlueNord ASA
summary: BlueNord ASA, an Oslo-based oil and gas firm established in 2005, specializes in discovering, developing, and producing hydrocarbons. Its operations span Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands, and the UK, with significant production assets located on the Danish Continental Shelf. The company adopted the name BlueNord ASA in April 2023, having previously operated as Norwegian Energy Company ASA.
